deviations.claim_in_article: They also temporarily put back the feature in which humans handled the calls.
deviations.issue: This says the human-call feature was restored, whereas the Ledger says Meta rolled back the human-concierge feature. “Temporarily” does not correct the reversal in meaning.
deviations.explanation: The feature’s status is reversed: the Ledger records a rollback, but the article says it was put back. This is a changed fact and negation; the temporary qualifier does not make the claim consistent.
